, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: Fabricated/unsupported “manual” data and conclusions. They claimed TripAdvisor review counts, average ratings, and “fully wheelchair accessible” mentions (≥3) for Mist Trail, Vernal & Nevada Falls via Mist Trail, and Upper Yosemite Falls—trails that are not wheelchair accessible—without citing actual TripAdvisor evidence. They also relied on AllTrails for one entry (not TripAdvisor), violating the source and verification requirements. This directly produced the incorrect final solution.
